title.en: Vector spaces, bases, rank, and identifiability
title.zh: 向量空间、基、秩与可辨识性

lead.en: Prove subspace and basis claims, compute four fundamental spaces, derive rank–nullity, and distinguish unique predictions from unique parameters.
lead.zh: 证明子空间与基，计算四个基本空间，推导秩–零化度，区分预测唯一与参数唯一。

prerequisites.en: Modules 04 and 10: proof structure, linear maps, equivalent row operations, pivots and free variables. NumPy preparation is needed for the numerical labs.
prerequisites.zh: 模块 04 与 10：证明结构、线性映射、等价行操作、主元与自由变量。数值实验需 NumPy 准备。

en: Test subspace closure with complete quantifiers and counterexamples.
Find a spanning independent basis and unique basis coordinates.
Distinguish row, column, null and left-null spaces with their ambient dimensions.
Prove finite-dimensional rank–nullity and classify Ax=b using it.
Exhibit parameter families with identical predictions and delimit training-only equivalence.
Report exact rank separately from scale- and tolerance-dependent numerical rank.
zh: 按完整量词与反例检验子空间封闭。
找张成且独立的基及唯一基坐标。
区分行、列、零与左零空间及其所在维度。
证明有限维秩–零化度并用于分类 Ax=b。
给出预测相同的参数族，限定只在训练集等价的情形。
区分精确秩与依赖尺度、容差的数值秩。

text.en: Read Sections 1–2 and prove the closure test.
text.zh: 阅读第 1–2 节并证明封闭判据。
阅读向量空间与基选段。

text.en: Explain the zero vector, span and dependence without notes.
text.zh: 不看笔记解释零向量、张成与相关。

text.en: Read Sections 3–4 and track ambient dimensions.
text.zh: 阅读第 3–4 节并追踪所在维度。

text.en: Run exact elimination and verify null-space bases.
text.zh: 运行精确消元并验证零空间基。

text.en: Read Sections 5–6; follow the basis-extension proof.
text.zh: 阅读第 5–6 节并跟随基扩张证明。

text.en: Compare equivalent weights on training and new records.
text.zh: 在训练与新记录上比较等价权重。

text.en: Contrast exact rank with explicit numerical tolerances.
text.zh: 比较精确秩与明确数值容差。

text.en: Complete choices and the written equivalence argument.
text.zh: 完成选择与书面等价论证。
阅读 NumPy 秩的阈值约定。

text.en: Use the span explorer and complete the exit task.
text.zh: 使用张成探索器并完成结业任务。
